about_the_game:
About This Game
SHEROK's Case ; Recollection is a mystery visual novel that weaves together investigative drama and a unique yuri (girls’ love) relationship at its core.
Featuring expressive Live2D animation, branching dialogue choices, and an atmospheric soundtrack, the game invites players into a world where every word and gesture matters.

The story follows Sherok, a private consulting detective, and a mysterious girl named Watōjima who appears at her side. As they confront strange cases and hidden truths, the narrative explores memory, identity, and the fragile bonds between people.

Key Features

  • Mystery × Yuri visual novel with deep character relationships

  • Expressive Live2D animations that bring characters to life

  • Branching dialogue choices that affect pacing and nuance

  • An atmospheric soundtrack that enhances immersion

  • Themes of memory, identity, and fragile human connections

About This Demo
This demo version lets you experience Chapters 1 through 3 of SHEROK's Case ; Recollection.

  • Approximate playtime: 20–30 minutes

  • All major features of the full game are present (Live2D animation, dialogue choices, soundtrack, and mystery progression).

  • Your choices and impressions here are just the beginning—the full release will expand into additional cases, character arcs, and new story branches.

We encourage you to try the demo, meet Sherok and Watōjima, and see how their story begins.

※In this demo, you can choose between Japanese and English when starting a new game.

Language cannot be changed from the title screen.

To switch languages, please restart the demo and select your preferred option at the beginning.
